Ok, so if you don't want to spend any real world money on the game it's still very easy to play and access all the content, but a lot of the premium content is cool and fun to have yeah? So here's the thing, most of the premium accessories and outfits and items can be sold so you can still get them reliably without spending any money, but don't expect them to be cheap, the imperative thing here is to work hard and smart.

  • TACOs and XQs

-ok so this is one of the best ways to collect a lot of Meseta (the in-game money) it's relatively fast and easy if you do it right and it's avalible to everyone

So TACOs are Time Attack Client Orders and XQs are extreme quests. I can't remember exactly when but by lvl 50 you should have access to both, then you want to unlock all the difficulties and the free field quest for every area and you'll be all set

Now on the second floor of the gate area on the right side there's an annoying red space cowboy NPC named Klotho here's important as you unlock the variety of aforementioned quests he starts offering Client Orders (basically jobs or missions whatever) that all together pay out around 2 or 3 mil meseta if you have all of them and you can redo them once a week every week

they're each their own kind of complicated so I'll save explaining how to do them for their own separate posts

  • Daily Orders

-so daily orders or DOs for short are a selection of client orders availible to you that resets every day (if you accept one you can keep it for as long as you like even if it takes you more than a day to finish) and they're worth a good ammount of money every day that increases as you have access to more and harder mission to do them on

it's not a lot of money but it's free and easy to get and something you can do everyday to work at saving up a larger ammount and once you have a support partner they can do the "collect" type ones for you

  • Player Shop

-So there's an in-game player shop and some of you who have played a little are probably thinking "isn't that premium content" and well yes and no it mostly is the easiest way to use it is to have a premium account or buy a 30 day pass with real money but there is a work around if you play the fun scratch it's possible to get 3 day shop tickets and save them up (don't use them till you have a lot of stuff to sell)

now as for what to sell it can be pretty random but I'll give some suggestions on what you can do for free

items with a blue crossout symbol next to their icon can't be sold

-any items that you buy with badges and at the recycle or fun points shop could sell for a lot if they're harder to get or not over sold by others on the same server

-any rare weapons or lvl 1-10 techniques that are hard to get should fetch a decent price

-higher rarity weapons that have been fully extended and Potential unlocked sell for a lot (I'll explain the Weapon lab later) but getting them to this point can be very costly itself so this is risky

-if you play the smart phone version too (PSO2es) and have it connected to the main version it's easy to come across a lot of weapons and units with the soul receptor ability which should sell decently

-you can kind of play the stock market with the shop if you are careful and save up alot of meseta first but this is risky and unpredictable so I'd be careful but if there's a rare item that's selling well on the market you could buy out all the cheaper postings of it and try to sell it for more when less people are selling them you don't need a pass to buy things just to sell them

-Grinders, Synthesizers, Photon Spheres, Grind Success Rate and crafting items, things people need a lot of, can sell well to if you wait for a good time to sell

also many of the emergency quests pay out a decent amount of EXP and Mesta make sure you turn auto-pick up mesta on in your options and use boosts for meseta and EXP when doing EQs

Things from specific shops such as Photon Shop, ExCube shop and the Casino prize counter can't be traded or sold. I think some items from the Recycle Shop can be sold, as well as items from the Badge Exchange Shop.
